versions.content: If the swCalibrationAccess of an ArgumentDataProto- type used in an interface of a client-server port of a SwComponentPrototype is set to readOnly and RteMeasurementSupport is set to true the RTE Generator shall create a McDataInstance element with • symbol set to the C-symbol name used for the allocation (see also [SWS_Rte_03901]) • flatMapEntry referencing to the corresponding FlatInstanceDescriptor element of the ArgumentDataPrototype
